translations.web: The wind goes toward the south, and turns around to the north. It turns around continually as it goes, and the wind returns again to its courses.
translations.bsb: The wind blows southward, then turns northward; round and round it swirls, ever returning on its course.
translations.kjv: The wind goeth toward the south, and turneth about unto the north; it whirleth about continually, and the wind returneth again according to his circuits.
translations.asv: The wind goeth toward the south, and turneth about unto the north; it turneth about continually in its course, and the wind returneth again to its circuits.
